administration.target: English-speaking adults 18+; Chinese research draft not validated and no minor-use generalization.
administration.mode: CASI validated; paper/online possible; equivalence of oral or other modes not established.
administration.recall: No fixed recall window; general self-description.
administration.instruction_en: Below you will find statements that people often use to describe themselves. Please use the scale below to indicate the extent to which these statements accurately describe you. There are no right or wrong answers.
administration.instruction_zh_ai: 下面是一些人们常用来描述自己的陈述。请使用下列选项，指出这些陈述在多大程度上准确地描述了您。答案没有对错。

response_options.en: does not describe me at all

items.en: I view challenging situations as an opportunity to grow and learn.
items.zh_ai: 我把有挑战的情境看作成长和学习的机会。

items.en: I seek out situations where it is likely that I will have to think in depth about something.
items.zh_ai: 我会主动寻找可能需要深入思考某件事的情境。

items.en: I enjoy learning about subjects that are unfamiliar to me.
items.zh_ai: 我喜欢学习自己不熟悉的主题。

items.en: I find it fascinating to learn new information.
items.zh_ai: 我觉得学习新信息很有吸引力。

items.en: Thinking about solutions of difficult conceptual problems can keep me awake at night.
items.zh_ai: 思考困难的概念性问题的解法，可能会让我夜里睡不着。

items.en: I can spend hours on a single problem because I just can’t rest without knowing the answer.
items.zh_ai: 我可能在一个问题上花上好几个小时，因为不知道答案就无法安心。

items.en: I feel frustrated if I can’t figure out the solution to a problem, so I work even harder to solve it.
items.zh_ai: 如果想不出问题的解法，我会感到受挫，所以会更加努力地解决它。

items.en: I work relentlessly at problems that I feel must be solved.
items.zh_ai: 对于我觉得必须解决的问题，我会坚持不懈地钻研。

items.en: The smallest doubt can stop me from seeking out new experiences.
items.zh_ai: 哪怕一点点疑虑，也能让我不再寻求新的体验。

items.en: I cannot handle the stress that comes from entering uncertain situations.
items.zh_ai: 我无法应对进入不确定情境所带来的压力。

items.en: I find it hard to explore new places when I lack confidence in my abilities.
items.zh_ai: 当我对自己的能力缺乏信心时，我觉得很难探索新的地方。

items.en: It is difficult to concentrate when there is a possibility that I will be taken by surprise.
items.zh_ai: 当有可能发生令我措手不及的事情时，我很难集中注意力。

items.en: I like finding out why people behave the way they do.
items.zh_ai: 我喜欢弄清楚人们为什么会那样行事。

items.en: I ask a lot of questions to figure out what interests other people.
items.zh_ai: 我会问很多问题，以了解其他人对什么感兴趣。

items.en: When talking to someone who is excited, I am curious to find out why.
items.zh_ai: 和一个兴奋的人交谈时，我会好奇是什么让对方兴奋。

items.en: When talking to someone, I try to discover interesting details about them.
items.zh_ai: 与人交谈时，我会尝试发现对方身上一些有趣的细节。

items.en: When other people are having a conversation, I like to find out what it’s about.
items.zh_ai: 其他人在交谈时，我喜欢弄清楚他们在谈什么。

items.en: When around other people, I like listening to their conversations.
items.zh_ai: 和其他人在一起时，我喜欢听他们的交谈。

items.en: When people quarrel, I like to know what’s going on.
items.zh_ai: 人们争吵时，我喜欢知道发生了什么。

items.en: I seek out information about the private lives of people in my life.
items.zh_ai: 我会寻求有关我生活中那些人的私生活的信息。

items.en: Risk-taking is exciting to me.
items.zh_ai: 冒险让我感到兴奋。

items.en: When I have free time, I want to do things that are a little scary.
items.zh_ai: 有空闲时间时，我想做一些有点吓人的事情。

items.en: Creating an adventure as I go is much more appealing than a planned adventure.
items.zh_ai: 比起事先安排好的冒险，我觉得在过程中即兴展开的冒险要吸引人得多。

items.en: I prefer friends who are excitingly unpredictable.
items.zh_ai: 我更喜欢那些让人感到兴奋、难以预测的朋友。

chineseEvidence.package_status: AI initial translation, unvalidated; independent bilingual review pending.
chineseEvidence.citation: Tian, Y., Huang, Q., Liu, X., Zhang, J., Ye, Y., & Wu, H. (online 2024; print 2025). Unraveling the Intricacies of Curiosity: A Comprehensive Study of Its Measures in the Chinese Context. PsyCh Journal, 14(2), 219–234.
chineseEvidence.sample: N=723, ages 18–53, mean 22.11 (SD 4.35); 455 women; 654 students and 69 employed.
chineseEvidence.evidence: Six-factor 5DCR: CFI .89, TLI .88, RMSEA .06, SRMR .05; authors retained six factors despite CFI/TLI below .90. Facet omegas .732–.842.
chineseEvidence.version_rights: Study translation prepared/proofread by first five authors. Exact translation rights and correspondence to this AI draft not established; no copying of that Chinese text, no transfer of its validity to this draft.
chineseEvidence.equivalence: No English/Chinese equivalence or Chinese norms claimed.
